text: when placing props, this is what a ghost piece looks like: [Image #5] and here is the prop: [Image #6] they look nothing alike. this happens on every prop. u have no idea what it is til its placed
resolution: Prop placement ghosts in the iso build pane were a thin def.size box that looked nothing like the placed prop ('you have no idea what it is til its placed'). Root cause: all three iso ghost paths (placement/move/paint) ran every armed piece through pieceVisualShapes, which has no shape decomposition for props and falls through to one def.size slab, while a PLACED prop renders via the real <Prop> model. Fix: added a shared GhostPiece component (editors/build/pieceMeshes.tsx) that mounts the SAME <Prop> renderer the standing world uses for prop pieces, keeping the translucent box/ramp decomposition for walls/floors/ramps/stairs/elevators; blocked placements lay the red def.size footprint over the model so the refusal still reads. Routed all three ghost useMemos in IsoAuthor.tsx through it. Verified: cart bundles clean (esbuild exit 0, no warnings).
